jobs.name: 行舟短发
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent modular hair artwork for our Chinese ink-wash cultivation character portraits. INPUT 1: our own warm charcoal hair material swatch, ONLY for colour, fine hand-painted fibres and matte ink shadows. INPUT 2: OUR OWN bald portrait, ONLY for frontal skull width, crown curvature, forehead/temple proportion and head axis. Output ONLY the requested HAIR COMPONENT, no head, face, skin, ears, eyes, brows, neck or clothes. Preserve our fine painterly ink detail; no photorealism, CGI shine, white streaks, glossy plastic or flat anime shading. Warm charcoal black with soft restrained warm grey highlights. STYLE CHANGE: straight, SIMPLE, clean, calm hair flow with a FEW large coherent smooth strand groups. Minimal broken ends, NO curls, NO inward hooks, NO messy spikes, NO shaggy feathering, NO windblown flyaways. Natural compact crown, no tall dome and no flattened wide helmet. Strict level FRONT view, head axis vertical; balanced left/right skull volume and temple heights. IMPORTANT SKULL FIT: the hair cap must be wide enough to wrap the entire bald head reference. Do not taper the temples inward above the ear roots. Continuous substantial side hair outside both scalp contours down to upper-ear height. Shape must have enough width at the LOWER temples as well as at the upper crown, not just a wide top and narrow bottom. True transparent alpha with ample padding around the full component; no background, glow, shadow, ear-shaped notches, text or labels.
Subject and layer ownership: FRONT HAIR. Male cultivated, neat straight short haircut: clean shallow central separation, two gently backward-combed smooth sides, a few short straight fine tapered bangs lying in the upper forehead. Forehead below bangs fully open. The cap sides continue fairly vertically outside the temples and end at upper-ear height, with tiny straight close sideburns, no inward pinching. Soft compact top that fits the wide skull. No thick pointed fringe or fluffy modern anime silhouette. Rear nape hair excluded.
